So clicking a gray cell turns it green (N). Interesting! Green is the color of the timer bar. So maybe the goal is to turn all cells green? Or green = "selected/active"?
Wait, let me actually look at the image again: the top-left cell is green. So the click changed g → N (green).

Actually, the goal might be to make the grid match the purple pattern: the purple dots are at N/W/E/S (top-center, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-center) — those are exactly the positions of the white cells! So the white cells indicate the target pattern, and you need to turn those cells green (or "active")? The click turned the top-left gray cell green, but that's not part of the pattern.
Or maybe the goal is to turn all cells green. Let me click a white cell and see what happens.
